Inputs: household1–8, monthly earned/unearned income, necessary dependent care, state-allowed child support, elderly/disabled flag and medical costs, rent/mortgage plus state-approved utility allowance. Standard deductions [217,217,217,229,268,308,308,308]; 20% earned deduction; medical excess above$35 where eligible; excess shelter above half adjusted income, cap$769 unless elderly/disabled. Max allotments [306,562,808,1023,1217,1463,1616,1841]; subtract ceil(0.3×net). Show raw formula and conditional eligible1–2-member $25 minimum distinctly; suppress an award-like amount above federal net reference unless the user explicitly confirms a state eligibility determination. No estimate for AK/HI/territories or9+; link official tables. Defaults are a disclosed hypothetical four-person case. Copy/download result and inputs; no server submission.
